principle: Preserve the five-star PDE-002 subject treatment and the supplied light-background foundation while making each of the seven background concepts unmistakably different at the 280-pixel mobile review size. This is a visibility-calibration round, so a treatment may go too far.

recipes.name: Visible momentum wake
recipes.description: A broad warm wake becomes clearly legible behind the pose, establishing how much directional atmosphere the portrait can tolerate.

recipes.name: Visible emulsion bloom
recipes.description: Large overlapping density blooms visibly gather and dissolve while retaining the supplied photographic background.

recipes.name: Visible floating print
recipes.description: A broader shifting cast shadow deliberately tests the point where physical separation becomes either dimensional or cutout-like.

recipes.name: Visible negative-space aperture
recipes.description: The space around the face and gesture opens against a visibly deepening perimeter, testing a portrait-like vignette without a literal spotlight.

recipes.name: Visible residual gesture
recipes.description: Displaced traces of the pose become visible enough to judge whether remembered gesture adds energy or merely reads as an echo.

recipes.name: Visible incomplete geometry
recipes.description: Thicker arcs, points, and partial relationships intentionally approach the graphic boundary so the concept can finally be evaluated.

recipes.name: Visible borrowed-color field
recipes.description: Broad fields borrow visibly restrained skin and clothing color, testing whether chromatic atmosphere can connect the person to the empty space.
